hero.title: 深度研究应用
hero.summary: 面向高不确定性研究任务的具体应用，强调来源跟踪、证据组织、主动转向和长期知识沉淀。

taskTemplates.title: 研究一个开放问题
taskTemplates.goal: 给出研究问题、范围和输出标准，要求应用组织证据链并沉淀结论。
taskTemplates.description: 适合不确定性较高的资料研究。
exampleTasks: 请研究“AI 搜索会不会改变中小内容网站的流量结构”，重点看证据而不是观点口号。
帮我判断一个说法是否可靠：远程办公一定会降低团队创新效率。
我想了解某个新技术是否值得投入，请先梳理它的真实进展、限制和反对意见。
expectedOutputs: 结论摘要：明确回答、可信程度、关键依据和不能确定的部分。
证据清单：来源、主要事实、支持或反对的方向，以及证据强弱。
后续验证清单：还需要查什么、问谁、用什么数据补强。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 形成有证据边界的研究结论

taskTemplates.title: 为复杂选择做研究简报
taskTemplates.goal: 输入备选方案、决策目标和限制条件，让应用比较证据、风险与取舍。
taskTemplates.description: 适合采购、选型、战略判断和投入优先级讨论。
exampleTasks: 我们要在自建客服系统和购买 SaaS 之间做选择，请从成本、风险和长期维护比较。
帮我研究是否应该把团队知识库从 Notion 迁到本地方案，输出决策建议。
我想选择一套线上课程平台，请比较适合小团队使用的方案和隐藏成本。
expectedOutputs: 方案对比表：优势、代价、适用条件、风险和放弃理由。
推荐结论：首选方案、备选方案、触发改变选择的条件。
决策前问题清单：需要补充确认的预算、人员、时间和外部约束。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 形成可讨论、可追责的决策简报

taskTemplates.title: 追踪行业或政策变化
taskTemplates.goal: 输入行业、地区和时间范围，让应用整理近期变化、影响对象和下一步观察点。
taskTemplates.description: 适合持续关注市场、政策、技术路线和竞争变化。
exampleTasks: 请追踪近一年开源大模型工具链的变化，重点看哪些变化会影响小团队开发。
帮我研究某地教育科技政策变化，整理对培训机构和学校采购的影响。
我想了解数字人直播行业的真实进展，请区分宣传、已落地案例和风险。
expectedOutputs: 变化时间线：重要事件、发生时间、涉及主体和影响范围。
影响分析：受益者、受损者、短期影响和长期不确定性。
观察清单：值得持续关注的信号、关键词和下一轮检索方向。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 形成可持续更新的趋势研究记录

hero.title: Deep Research
hero.summary: A focused application for high-uncertainty research. It emphasizes source tracking, evidence organization, proactive course correction, and durable knowledge capture.

taskTemplates.title: Research an open question
taskTemplates.goal: Provide the research question, scope, and output standard so the application can organize an evidence chain and capture its conclusion.
exampleTasks: Research whether AI search will change the traffic structure of small and medium content websites. Focus on evidence rather than slogans.
Help me judge whether this claim is reliable: remote work always reduces team innovation.
I want to know whether a new technology is worth investing in. First map its real progress, limitations, and objections.
expectedOutputs: Conclusion summary: a direct answer, confidence level, key evidence, and what remains uncertain.
Evidence list: sources, core facts, supporting or opposing direction, and evidence strength.
Follow-up validation list: what to investigate next, whom to ask, and what data would strengthen the conclusion.
taskTemplates.currentObjective: Reach a research conclusion with clear evidence boundaries

taskTemplates.title: Create a research brief for a complex decision
taskTemplates.goal: Provide the options, decision goal, and constraints so the application can compare evidence, risks, and trade-offs.
taskTemplates.description: For procurement, selection, strategic judgment, and investment-priority discussions.
exampleTasks: We must choose between building a customer-service system and buying SaaS. Compare cost, risk, and long-term maintenance.
Research whether our team should move its knowledge base from Notion to a local solution, then recommend a decision.
I want to choose an online course platform. Compare options for a small team and their hidden costs.
expectedOutputs: Option comparison: benefits, costs, fit conditions, risks, and reasons to reject each option.
Recommendation: primary and fallback choices, plus conditions that would change the decision.
Pre-decision questions: budget, people, time, and external constraints that still need confirmation.
taskTemplates.currentObjective: Produce a discussable, accountable decision brief

taskTemplates.title: Track industry or policy changes
taskTemplates.goal: Provide the industry, region, and time range so the application can organize recent changes, affected groups, and the next observation points.
taskTemplates.description: For ongoing monitoring of markets, policy, technology paths, and competitive shifts.
exampleTasks: Track changes in open-source large-model toolchains over the past year, focusing on what affects small-team development.
Research changes in education-technology policy in a region and summarize the impact on training providers and school procurement.
I want to understand the real progress of virtual-host livestreaming. Separate promotion, deployed cases, and risks.
expectedOutputs: Change timeline: important events, dates, stakeholders, and scope of impact.
Impact analysis: beneficiaries, affected parties, short-term effects, and long-term uncertainty.
Watch list: signals, keywords, and search directions worth tracking next.
taskTemplates.currentObjective: Create a continuously updatable trend-research record
